description: Horizontal user story map with activity columns and drag-and-drop between columns

attributes.name: src
attributes.description: URL to JSON data with activities and stories. Fetched once per value; a new value replaces the map and aborts an older in-flight request

attributes.name: title
attributes.description: Optional heading above the story map; also names the scroll region

attributes.name: compact
attributes.description: Reduces column widths, padding, and header font sizes for denser layouts

childAttributes.name: data-activity-label
childAttributes.description: Display label for the column header

childAttributes.name: data-journey-phase
childAttributes.description: Optional link to a user-journey phase

events.name: story-map:ready
events.description: Fired once after the first render. With src, fired once the JSON has loaded and rendered. Once per element: not re-fired by a later src change (watch activities-changed with source 'src') or when the map is moved in the DOM

events.name: story-map:activities-changed
events.description: Fired after each .activities assignment (source 'property') and after each src load has rendered (source 'src')

events.name: story-map:upgraded
events.description: Fired (in a microtask) each time the map connects and upgrades
